hero.intro: I build practical tools and solve problems for education, businesses and community by turning messy, manual processes into automated systems to make people's life easier.

about.heading: A builder with an eye for impact.
about.intro: I turn manual, messy processes into clear tools — usually with a spreadsheet, a sensor, or a little code.
paragraphs: I'm a student developer with a strong foundation in coding, mathematics and technology integration. I specialise in creating impactful educational tools, and I have experience developing solutions that improve learning for both teachers and students.

Most of my work starts with a real person and a frustrating, manual process — a teacher compiling reports by hand, a driver unsure how far they travelled, or a logistics team tracking hundreds of schools in a spreadsheet. I like taking that mess and turning it into something clear, reliable and genuinely useful.

work.heading: Tools built for real people.
work.intro: Twelve projects across apps, web, hardware and AI. Each one started with a specific problem — and was built to make someone’s day a little lighter.

projects.title: Kayam Tracking App
projects.summary: This made sure that every part of the process was automated, with no mistakes or missing data, making it much easier and faster to track all the tablets sent to schools.
projects.timelineNote: A QR-based registration tool for tracking tablets across Sarawak.

paragraphs: Many students who are already ten years older can’t speak or read.
Government is sending hundreds of tablets across Sarawak. The tablet contains the Kayam app, which helps trailing students.
Hard to track and verify that the tablets have been delivered.

I developed a Python-based registration tool integrated with Google Sheets API so that I could get real-time data for when the tablets are received. The system automatically logs, verifies, and monitors the tablets that are distributed.
This made sure that every part of the process was automated, with no mistakes or missing data, making it much easier and faster to track all the tablets sent to schools.

projects.title: Map Mileage Calculator
projects.summary: This helps provide proof of the actual distance driven and ensures that each driver gets paid the correct amount based on accurate data.
projects.timelineNote: A map-based tool for calculating driver mileage and earnings.

paragraphs: The drivers who delivered the tablets didn’t know how much they would earn for each trip.

I built a web-based tool that uses mapping data to automatically calculate the distance and total mileage between locations. It then calculates the driver’s earnings based on the number of kilometers covered.
This helps provide proof of the actual distance driven and ensures that each driver gets paid the correct amount based on accurate data.

projects.title: Chumbaka Student Project Report Tool
projects.summary: At the end of each term, a PDF report is automatically generated to show each student’s progress and achievements, making it easier for teachers to highlight outstanding projects.
projects.timelineNote: An AppSheet report system for Chumbaka student projects.

paragraphs: Chumbaka don’t have a proper system to analyze and showcase the good projects that students have completed. Everything had to be done manually, which took a lot of time and effort.

I created an AppSheet-based system integrated with Google Sheets. Teachers can submit student projects through a digital form that includes photos and descriptions. The tool then automatically compiles and generates personalized reports for each student.
At the end of each term, a PDF report is automatically generated to show each student’s progress and achievements, making it easier for teachers to highlight outstanding projects.

projects.title: Wake Up Ah Kong Project
projects.summary: Improved safety and independence for the elderly, providing peace of mind to family members through proactive alert systems.
projects.timelineNote: An Arduino assistive device for safer bed exits.

paragraphs: My grandfather faced difficulty waking up safely due to mobility and balance issues.
Designed an Arduino-based assistive device using ultrasonic sensors, sound effects, and visual indicators to detect when he approaches the bed edge.
Improved safety and independence for the elderly, providing peace of mind to family members through proactive alert systems.

projects.title: COVID-19 Vaccine Temperature Monitor
projects.summary: Prevented potential vaccine spoilage and ensured safe distribution during the pandemic, contributing to reliable healthcare logistics.

Created an Arduino-based temperature monitoring system with real-time LED and sound alerts to detect deviations from the safe temperature range.

projects.title: Spinning Star Alarm Clock

Designed a creative alarm clock that plays “Mary Had a Little Lamb,” lights up with blinking LEDs, and spins a star when the alarm triggers.
Transformed waking up into a fun and engaging experience, combining creativity, music, and technology in everyday life.

projects.title: Alpha Course Data Analysis Tool (HTBB)
projects.summary: This helped the HTBB team quickly gain clear insights into their participants, allowing them to improve outreach strategies and plan future Alpha sessions more effectively.
projects.timelineNote: A one-click analysis tool for 11 years of Alpha Course data.

paragraphs: After 11 years of running the Alpha Course, the organizers still didn’t have clear information about the participants, such as their age, church attendance, or reasons for joining. All the data was there, but it wasn’t analyzed in a useful way.

I developed an automated analysis tool in Google Sheets that processes all the participant data with just one click. It organizes information such as age, church attendance, and reasons for attending, making it easy to understand the overall trends.
This helped the HTBB team quickly gain clear insights into their participants, allowing them to improve outreach strategies and plan future Alpha sessions more effectively.

projects.title: Young Innovators Challenge Judging System
projects.summary: This digital judging system will be used for the national finals of the Young Innovators Challenge in 2025, making the entire judging process faster, more accurate, and more efficient.
projects.timelineNote: A real-time judging system for the Young Innovators Challenge.

paragraphs: Judges in the Young Innovators Challenge had to evaluate projects using paper form, which made it difficult to update or change scores based on students’ performance. The process was slow and not very flexible.

I developed an AppSheet-based form that allows judges to submit, edit, and manage scores easily in real time. The interface is simple, seamless, and helps judges focus more on the evaluation rather than paperwork.
This digital judging system will be used for the national finals of the Young Innovators Challenge in 2025, making the entire judging process faster, more accurate, and more efficient.

projects.title: AI Panel in Google Sheets
projects.summary: An AI assistant inside Google Sheets that answers questions about a 204-school tablet rollout — deadlines, overdue tasks and contacts — without scanning thousands of rows.
projects.timelineNote: An AI assistant embedded in Google Sheets for a 204-school tablet rollout.

paragraphs: All over Sarawak, many schools don't have opportunities for students to catch up in their studies. Some students can't even read or write. There are many people involved in helping them: teachers, delivery drivers and volunteers.

The problems start before the tablets are even delivered. The devices are loaded with educational material from the Kayam App, but managing a 204-school logistics rollout is complex — and the people involved have no easy way to see what is overdue or what is coming next.
How can we make it easy for everyone involved to know what is overdue and what the upcoming deadlines are?

bullets.title: Students left behind
bullets.text: Many schools in Sarawak lack opportunities for students to catch up; some can't even read or write.

bullets.title: Logistics complexity
bullets.text: Teachers, delivery drivers and volunteers all need to coordinate across 204 schools.

bullets.title: Deadline visibility
bullets.text: There was no easy way to know which tasks were overdue or which deadlines were approaching.

bullets.title: Data overload
bullets.text: Over 1,000 rows of tracking data made manual lookups slow and error-prone.

paragraphs: Mr Chong, my teacher at Chumbaka, suggested developing an AI agent inside Google Sheets that could answer questions based on what users ask. The agent works like a human assistant — except it has everything stored in the database.

I connected ChatGPT to Google Sheets with Google Apps Script, then solved the scaling problem by adding a vector database. Instead of re-reading a thousand-page book every time, the agent flips straight to the paragraph it needs.

cards.title: The tool: Google Sheets
cards.text: Used Google Sheets because of prior experience, leveraging Google Apps Script and Python to build the solution.

cards.title: The initial challenge
cards.text: At the start, I wasn't even sure it would work. Eventually I connected ChatGPT to Google Sheets and coded it to respond to simple questions before reading sheet data.

cards.title: Scaling to 1,000+ rows
cards.text: Getting the AI to read all the data was like giving someone a 1,000-page book and asking one question. It was too slow and too costly to repeat every time.

cards.title: The vector database
cards.text: The AI now uses a smart index to find the exact passage instantly. Data syncs to the cloud manually or every one to two hours.

paragraphs: The final product lets anyone using the sheet get their question answered immediately, without slowly searching across rows of content. It turns a data-heavy spreadsheet into a conversation.

features.title: Deadline tracking
features.text: Ask about upcoming deadlines and get an instant answer without scanning the entire sheet.
bullets: "What is the next deadline I should watch out for?"
"What are some unfinished tasks even though the deadline has passed?"

features.title: Contact lookup
features.text: Find who to contact for a specific region or task without searching through rows.
bullets: "Who should I contact in PPD Kuching?"

features.title: Deliverable status
features.text: Check whether all tasks have been met for every deliverable with a single question.
bullets: "Have all the tasks been met for every deliverable?"

journey.label: Step 1
journey.title: Problem identified
journey.description: Schools in Sarawak lack catch-up opportunities. Managing a 204-school tablet rollout with many stakeholders is complex and deadlines are hard to track.

journey.label: Step 2
journey.title: The idea
journey.description: Mr Chong from Chumbaka suggested an AI agent inside Google Sheets — a human-like assistant with everything stored in the database.

journey.label: Step 3
journey.title: Connecting ChatGPT
journey.description: Connected ChatGPT to Google Sheets using Apps Script, then taught the agent to answer simple questions before reading sheet information.

journey.label: Step 4
journey.title: The scaling challenge
journey.description: Tried getting the AI to read all 1,000+ rows. Like giving someone a 1,000-page book — too slow and too much energy to re-read every time.

journey.label: Step 5
journey.title: The vector database
journey.description: Implemented a vector database that searches by meaning rather than exact words. The agent flips to the exact paragraph it needs.

journey.label: Step 6
journey.title: The final product
journey.description: Users can now ask any question related to the data and get an instant answer — no more manually scanning thousands of rows.
